description: F0a foundation: bump apps/web TS target to ES2020 (so BigInt money math and the bigint-typed PaiseAmount compile under strict), add the F0 dependencies, initialize shadcn/ui in CSS-variables mode WITHOUT resetting the existing Tailwind palette, add the shadcn primitives, and wire a TanStack Query v5 + sonner provider into the root layout. Independent of later FEATs except that all of them depend on this one (ES2020 bump + providers + shadcn primitives are prerequisites).
steps: In apps/web/tsconfig.json set compilerOptions.target to "ES2020" and compilerOptions.lib to ["dom","dom.iterable","ES2020"]. Change NOTHING else. Reason: money.ts uses BigInt/bigint and PaiseAmount transforms to bigint; strict tsc rejects bigint under an ES2017 lib.

Add dependencies to apps/web/package.json and run npm install from the repo root. deps: @tanstack/react-query (v5), jwt-decode, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, zod (match packages/shared's ^3.23), class-variance-authority, tailwindcss-animate, sonner, @radix-ui/react-dialog, @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu, @radix-ui/react-select, @radix-ui/react-label, @radix-ui/react-slot, @radix-ui/react-tabs, @radix-ui/react-separator, @radix-ui/react-avatar. devDeps: vitest, jsdom, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/dom, @vitejs/plugin-react. Pin exact/caret versions; tailwind-merge + clsx + lucide-react are already present.
Run `npx shadcn@latest init` in apps/web choosing CSS variables = YES (base color neutral). This creates apps/web/components.json and apps/web/src/lib/utils.ts (cn = clsx + tailwind-merge).

Reconcile tailwind.config.ts: keep theme.extend.colors.{primary,success,danger,warning} EXACTLY as they are today; ADD darkMode:["class"], the tailwindcss-animate plugin, and shadcn's semantic color aliases (border/input/ring/background/foreground/primary/secondary/destructive/muted/accent/card/popover referencing hsl var()) alongside the existing ramps.

Reconcile globals.css: ADD shadcn's :root and .dark CSS-variable blocks mapping to the design §3.8 hex table (primary-600 #2563eb -> --primary and --ring; danger-600 #dc2626 -> --destructive; gray-50 #f9fafb -> --background; gray-900 #111827 -> --foreground; white -> --card/--popover; gray-200/gray-300 -> --border/--input; gray-100 -> --muted; gray-500 -> --muted-foreground; gray-200 -> --secondary; gray-800 -> --secondary-foreground; primary-50 #eff6ff -> --accent; --radius 0.5rem), expressed as HSL. KEEP the existing @layer base body and @layer components (.btn-primary/.btn-danger/.btn-secondary/.card/.input/.label) blocks verbatim — re-add them exactly if the generator removed or reordered them.
Run `npx shadcn@latest add button input label card table dialog dropdown-menu select form badge tabs skeleton separator avatar` generating apps/web/src/components/ui/*.tsx.

Create apps/web/src/components/providers/AppProviders.tsx ("use client") that holds const [qc] = useState(() => new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { staleTime: 30000, gcTime: 300000, refetchOnWindowFocus: false, retry: (count, err) => (err instanceof ApiError && (err.status===401||err.status===403)) ? false : count < 2 }, mutations: { retry: false } } })) and renders <QueryClientProvider client={qc}>{children}<Toaster richColors position="top-right" /></QueryClientProvider>. Import ApiError from @/lib/api, Toaster from sonner.

Edit apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx (keep it a server component — do NOT add "use client") to import AppProviders and wrap {children}: <body className={inter.className}><AppProviders>{children}</AppProviders></body>.
acceptance_criteria: apps/web/tsconfig.json target is ES2020 and lib includes ES2020.
tailwind.config.ts still contains the primary(50-950)/success/danger/warning ramps verbatim AND the new shadcn aliases + tailwindcss-animate plugin + darkMode class.
globals.css still contains the @layer base body and @layer components .btn-*/.card/.input/.label blocks verbatim AND the new :root/.dark shadcn variable blocks.
layout.tsx wraps children in <AppProviders> and remains a server component.
Running `npm run lint -w @campusgate/web` passes and `npm run build -w @campusgate/web` succeeds.
verification: npm run build -w @campusgate/web   (next build — succeeds; GatePass pages still build with the provider mounted)
Manually diff tailwind.config.ts and globals.css to confirm the existing palette ramps and @layer components block are intact.
findings:
DONE on branch main. tsconfig.json target ES2020 + lib includes ES2020 (BigInt/bigint now compile under strict). Deps added to apps/web/package.json and installed via `npm install` at repo root (root package-lock.json updated): @tanstack/react-query ^5.62.0, jwt-decode ^4.0.0, react-hook-form ^7.54.0, @hookform/resolvers ^3.9.1, zod ^3.23.0 (matches shared), class-variance-authority ^0.7.1, tailwindcss-animate ^1.0.7, sonner ^1.7.1, @radix-ui/react-{dialog ^1.1.4, dropdown-menu ^2.1.4, select ^2.1.4, label ^2.1.1, slot ^1.1.1, tabs ^1.1.2, separator ^1.1.1, avatar ^1.1.2}; devDeps vitest ^2.1.8, jsdom ^25.0.1, @testing-library/react ^16.1.0, @testing-library/dom ^10.4.0, @vitejs/plugin-react ^4.3.4. (tailwind-merge/clsx/lucide-react were already present.)

SHADCN INIT CAVEAT for later FEATs: `npx shadcn@latest init` is now the new 3.x CLI which is INTERACTIVE (prompts for a 'preset' Nova/Vega/... theme) and would RESET the Tailwind palette — it cannot be driven headlessly without picking a preset that overwrites theme. So init was done MANUALLY to honor the 'do not reset theme' constraint: created apps/web/components.json (style new-york, tailwind config tailwind.config.ts, css src/app/globals.css, baseColor neutral, cssVariables true, rsc true, tsx true, aliases @/components|@/lib/utils|@/components/ui|@/lib|@/hooks, iconLibrary lucide) and apps/web/src/lib/utils.ts (cn = twMerge(clsx(...))). Primitives WERE added with the real CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add button input label card table dialog dropdown-menu select form badge tabs skeleton separator avatar --yes` — this worked non-interactively (components.json already present) and created all 14 files under apps/web/src/components/ui/ WITHOUT touching tailwind.config.ts or globals.css. If a later FEAT needs more primitives, use `npx shadcn@latest add <name> --yes` (NOT init). The ui/ primitives are new-york style, lucide icons, written for Tailwind 3 CSS-vars.

tailwind.config.ts: kept primary(50-950)/success/danger/warning ramps verbatim; ADDED darkMode:["class"], tailwindcss-animate plugin (via require), shadcn semantic aliases (border/input/ring/background/foreground/secondary/destructive/muted/accent/popover/card as hsl(var(--...))), borderRadius lg/md/sm from --radius, and accordion keyframes/animation. NOTE: primary now ALSO carries DEFAULT=hsl(var(--primary)) + foreground=hsl(var(--primary-foreground)) alongside the numeric ramp so shadcn's `bg-primary`/`text-primary-foreground` classes resolve while `bg-primary-600` etc. still work (Tailwind merges the object; numeric keys untouched).

globals.css: kept @layer base body and @layer components (.btn-primary/.btn-danger/.btn-secondary/.card/.input/.label) verbatim; ADDED a @layer base :root block + .dark block with the design §3.8 hex table expressed as HSL (--primary/--ring 221 83% 53%, --primary-foreground 0 0% 100%, --destructive 0 72% 51%, --background 210 20% 98%, --foreground 221 39% 11%, --card/--popover 0 0% 100%, --border/--secondary 220 13% 91%, --input 216 12% 84%, --muted 220 14% 96%, --muted-foreground 220 9% 46%, --secondary-foreground 215 28% 17%, --accent 214 100% 97% / --accent-foreground = primary, --radius 0.5rem). darkMode is class but unused (app is light-only).

AppProviders at apps/web/src/components/providers/AppProviders.tsx ("use client"): QueryClient with staleTime 30000, gcTime 300000, refetchOnWindowFocus false, queries.retry skips on ApiError 401/403 else count<2, mutations.retry false; renders QueryClientProvider + <Toaster richColors position="top-right"/> from sonner; imports ApiError from @/lib/api. layout.tsx stays a SERVER component (no 'use client') and wraps {children} in <AppProviders>.

VERIFICATION (this commit): `npm run lint -w @campusgate/web` (tsc --noEmit strict) PASSED (exit 0). `npm run build -w @campusgate/web` (next build) SUCCEEDED — all 28 existing GatePass routes compiled with the provider mounted; packages/shared/dist/index.js confirmed present before build. No money-path code introduced in this FEAT (no Number/parseFloat/* 100).
